Conclusion
Oman's high-end residential property market was USD 1.2 billion in 2024 and will likely reach USD 2.0 billion by 2032, growing at a wholesome CAGR of 6.8% from 2026 to 2032. One of the main reasons for this growth is Oman opening its real estate market to foreign investors. We at DarGlobal are leading the transformation with our iconic projects like The Great Escape , Marriott Residences , and Trump Cliff Villas . These real estate developments offer striking architecture, next-gen amenities, and high-yield investment opportunities for everyone in the country and outside it. Still confused? Let's see why you should invest in the Oman luxury real estate market !
The latest statistics indicated both local demand and increased foreign investment in Oman. Government-sponsored reforms, foreign-standard infrastructure, and luxury lifestyle options designed specifically for global citizens facilitate much of this expansion.
According to Oman's Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, luxury real estate deals are dominated by the capital city, Muscat, followed by integrated tourism complexes (ITCs) such as Al Mouj and Yiti. These are where Oman luxury real estate thrives, with sales setting records and increased rental yields.
Oman is on its way to changing the way we buy and invest in real estate in the Middle East region, and there are many reasons for Oman's luxury real estate investment boom, like:
One of the largest game-changers when purchasing property in Oman for expats is the provision for 100% foreign ownership in special areas referred to as Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITCs). Unlike most GCC countries, Oman has strategically identified places such as Al Mouj and Yiti where foreign nationals can buy freehold properties.
Oman’s Residency-by-Investment scheme makes property investment easy. It offers 5-year visas for investments of OMR 250,000+ and 10-year visas for investments of OMR 500,000+, respectively. This scheme offers secure accommodation and hugely boosts the attractiveness of purchasing property in Oman.
One of the biggest magnets for foreign investors is Oman's tax-friendly status, as there is no personal income tax, capital gains tax, or property tax on residential properties. Furthermore, with no inheritance tax and rigorous legal protection of foreign ownership, Oman offers a low-risk, high-reward environment for property investment.
We at DarGlobal are developing ultra-premium and luxury master projects that balance opulence with tranquility. Our projects, like The Trump Cliff Villas and Marriott Residences , are associated with internationally well-known and reputed brands, which tend to drive up property valuations and long-term rental yields.
One of the things that elevates global interest in Oman luxury real estate investment is its strategic geographic location, which is at the intersection of Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. Also, well-linked ports, international airports, and roadways make the country a center for trade and tourism.
Still, wondering what are the top locations in Oman to invest in today? Do not worry! Here, we have mentioned some of the prime locations that offer unmatched luxury and are ideal for expats and nationals to buy property in Oman.
Muscat, Oman's capital, remains one of the most desirable destinations for luxury real estate investors. The city has everything you need, from old-world mystique architecture to ultra-luxury amenities and social class. Shatti Al Qurum and Al Khuwair are famous for their high-end residential apartments and their proximity to international schools, embassies, and the Royal Opera House.
Al Mouj, or "The Wave," is a world-class ITC that embodies Oman luxury real estate. Built in association with the Oman government, this seafront destination boasts luxury villas, townhouses, and apartments designed with an international touch. From the Al Mouj Golf course to the luxury Kempinski Hotel and Marina, all of this development shouts high-end living. The quality of life and exclusivity provided here makes it perfect for foreign investment.
The Yiti and Yenkit areas are being transformed with a billion-dollar development driven by Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN) in collaboration with DarGlobal. AIDA Oman , one of DarGlobal's flagship developments, is setting new standards for coastal luxury living. The development will provide cliff-top villas, luxury resorts, and commercial promenades. Upon completion, Yiti & Yenkit will be Oman's response to upmarket coastal villages such as Amalfi and Saint-Tropez.
For expatriates, the process of buying property in Oman in Oman is simplified but controlled. Foreigners may buy property within specified ITCs only and must have it registered with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning.
Purchasers are awarded freehold ownership, and with this comes a bundle of related rights such as family visas and access to nearby services. Nevertheless, it is advisable to carry out due diligence, preferably through an authorized real estate agent or legal advisor. Moreover, the contracts must be notarized and all charges (usually 3-5% of the price of the property) must be clearly recorded. If these legal conditions are observed, the transaction is smooth and investor-friendly.
The growing demand for upscale properties indicates strong potential in Oman property investment with promising long-term financial returns.
There is growing demand for luxury villas and waterfront homes , especially from GCC investors and European buyers looking for picturesque, low-density settings. Coastal properties, including those in AIDA Oman or Al Mouj, are commanding premium values and provide high rental returns during tourist season.
Oman's tourism industry has been expanding steadily, as more than 3.5 million tourists were recorded in 2024 and the government is planning to double this number by 2027. Luxury resorts, adventure tourism, and heritage holidays are attracting high-spending visitors throughout the year.
Oman is making massive investments in infrastructure, new expressways, airports, and public transport networks are being built to facilitate tourism and real estate development. Initiatives such as the Muscat Metro and airport expansion are improving urban and suburban accessibility.
Oman luxury real estate appears promising, with Vision 2040 driving high-end development and foreign investor interest.
Vision 2040 under Oman looks to diversify the economy and increase foreign direct investment. Government incentives and collaborations with global developers imply that the luxury property market will continue to be bullish for the foreseeable future.
Coastal destinations such as Yiti, Duqm, and Salalah are being prepped for ultra-luxury resorts and villa communities. This expansion provides an early-entry benefit to investors prepared to use these picturesque but nascent locations.
To further encourage investment in Oman, the government will most likely extend residency-linked incentives. These may include more relaxed visa conditions, simpler family sponsorships, and even business establishment options linked to property investment.
Oman is making daring and calculated strides to welcome international citizens and expats on its beaches. From law reforms to high-end development-driven projects, the Sultanate is staking its claim as a top Oman property investment destination.
DarGlobal is honoured to be leading this change with our legendary projects such as The Great Escape 1 , The Marriott Residences , The Trump International Hotel & Trump Cliff Villas , Rizz Villas , and Coastal Investment Villas among others. Ready to Invest in a New Level of Luxury? Discover our high-end projects today and get your piece of paradise in Oman.

Qatar’s real estate market is experiencing impressive growth, with its total value expected to soar to $455.73 billion by 2025. This upward trajectory is driven by visionary development, economic stability, and investor-friendly regulations that open the doors wide for international buyers. But where do you start if you're a non-Qatari looking to invest? What does it take to invest with confidence in such a fantastic market? That’s precisely what this guide is here to answer.
We’ve broken down the entire property investment in Qatar journey into clear, simple steps for global investors ready to make smart, secure decisions. And with DarGlobal leading the way through exclusive, high-end developments that offer both luxury and long-term value. But before that, let’s see why people want to invest in Qatar’s real estate .
Qatar’s real estate sector is rapidly emerging as one of the most attractive investment destinations in the Middle East. As per the Ministry of Justice’s latest report, the market continues to perform strongly, with real estate transactions reaching QR 1.04 billion in December 2024 alone. This reflects growing investor interest in Qatar’s evolving property landscape.
The country’s GDP is projected to grow by 4.3% in 2025, driven by non-oil sectors like real estate and infrastructure. Also, Qatar's expansion of freehold zones for foreign direct investment, coupled with a stable political climate and residency incentives tied to property investments, has made Qatar an attraction for global investors.
Whether you're looking for full ownership, long-term lease rights, or access to luxury developments, understanding the legal structure is crucial to making informed decisions. Here are the key elements of the legal framework;
Foreign investors can purchase properties in designated freehold zones like The Pearl, Lusail, and West Bay Lagoon. As per Decision No. 28 of 2020, these areas offer full ownership rights, enabling expats to buy, sell, and lease properties without restrictions in prime locations.
This law significantly expanded property ownership rights for non-Qataris. Investors purchasing properties worth QAR 730,000 or more are eligible for residency permits, while investments exceeding QAR 3.65 million may offer permanent residency-like benefits, including access to public services.
Qatar's Real Estate Development Law regulates licensing, project approvals, and developer obligations. It ensures investor protection by mandating escrow accounts, clear delivery timelines, and construction standards, enhancing transparency, and reducing any risks for property investment in Qatar.
From luxury apartments and waterfront villas to serviced residences and commercial units, non-Qataris can explore numerous options in designated freehold and leasehold zones across the country. Here are the main types;
Apartments in Qatar offer modern, high-rise living in prime locations like The Pearl and Lusail. They range from cozy studios to spacious multi-bedroom units, often within gated communities, and feature amenities such as gyms, pools, and 24/7 security, making them ideal for expatriates.
Villas provide luxurious, private living with ample space, ideal for families or individuals seeking comfort and exclusivity. Found in areas like West Bay Lagoon or Al Waab, these properties often come with gardens, private pools, and parking, offering a serene lifestyle in a premium setting.
Townhouses blend the space of a villa with the convenience of apartment living. Located in master-planned communities like Viva Bahriya or Lusail, they offer multiple floors, private entrances, and shared amenities, appealing to those who desire a neighborhood feel with modern design and functionality.
Non-Qataris can invest in commercial properties in designated zones, such as Lusail and The Pearl. These include retail spaces, offices, and mixed-use buildings, offering long-term returns and business opportunities in Qatar’s growing economy, especially in the hospitality, retail, and corporate sectors.
Investing in Qatar’s real estate market is a promising opportunity for non-Qataris, thanks to investor-friendly laws, growing demand, and strategic developments. However, navigating the process requires careful planning. The below section outlines each essential step to help you invest confidently, legally, and profitably in Qatar’s property market.
Non-Qataris can buy freehold or leasehold properties in designated areas. So, familiarize yourself with property ownership laws, rights granted to foreign direct investment in Qatar, and government policies to ensure compliance.
Identify investment-friendly zones like The Pearl, Lusail, or West Bay. Consider factors like property type, lifestyle offerings, potential returns, and proximity to commercial centers, as each area caters to different needs.
Now, partner with a certified Qatar real estate agent experienced in assisting non-Qatari buyers. Their experience with foreign buyers ensures a smooth, transparent process from search to purchase, avoiding legal hurdles.
Verify the property’s legal status, developer reputation, ownership documents, and any outstanding liabilities. This step protects your property investment in Qatar, offering peace and reducing the chances of any legal or financial issues.
Once satisfied, sign a sale and purchase agreement outlining payment terms, handover timelines, and obligations. This document protects both buyer and seller, confirming your intent and initiating the official property transfer.
Now, register your property with the Ministry of Justice’s Real Estate Registration Department and pay the applicable fee (0.25% of value). The official registration finalizes ownership and generates your legal title deed.
Qatar offers several prime locations where non-Qataris can invest in Qatar real estate, each with unique advantages in lifestyle, rental yield, and growth potential. Here are some of the key locations for the best investment in Qatar;
A premier waterfront destination, The Pearl offers luxury apartments, townhouses, and villas with scenic marina views. Known for its upscale lifestyle, fine dining, and retail outlets, it’s a top choice for expatriates and investors seeking high-end living and strong rental returns.
Qatar’s futuristic smart city, Lusail, features residential, commercial, and entertainment zones. With ongoing developments, modern infrastructure, and venues like Lusail Stadium, it offers the best asset potential for non-Qataris looking to be part of Qatar’s expanding urban and economic growth.
As Doha’s business hub, West Bay houses high-rise apartments and commercial towers with stunning sea views. Its proximity to embassies, hotels, and government offices makes it ideal for professionals and investors targeting high rental demand in a prime central location.
Before investing in Qatar’s real estate market, it’s essential to understand the associated costs and tax obligations. From registration and legal fees to rental income tax and maintenance charges, here are key details involved;
A one-time registration fee of 0.25% of the property’s value is payable by the buyer. This government fee formalizes the ownership transfer and is essential for all legal documentation.
Buyers typically pay 1%–2% of the property value for legal services, which cover contract review, title verification, and due diligence to ensure compliance with Qatari real estate laws and ownership regulations.
Commission fees for real estate agents usually range from 1% to 5% of the property value. This cost is negotiated between the buyer and agent and reflects their role in facilitating the purchase.
Qatar taxes rental income at a flat 10% corporate rate if classified as business income. However, capital gains on property sales are generally exempt unless generated through ongoing commercial activity.
With the country’s Vision 2030 focusing on economic diversification, the demand for premium residential and mixed-use properties is expected to rise steadily, creating solid long-term value. DarGlobal is at the forefront with landmark developments tailored for international buyers seeking luxury .
Projects like L’Horizon by Elie Saab in Lusail redefine modern living with panoramic sea views and resort-style amenities. Similarly, Les Vagues by Elie Saab , located on Qetaifan Island North, is a masterpiece offering elegant residences with exclusive beach access.
These developments are expected to give strong ROI potential, mainly through capital appreciation and high rental yields. With average returns in areas like The Pearl reaching up to 8% , and branded properties attracting premium tenants, investors can expect high-value growth.
In conclusion, Qatar’s real estate market offers you a dynamic and secure investment condition for non-Qataris, backed by forward-thinking regulations, world-class infrastructure, and a stable economy. With high rental yields, rising demand, and access to residency incentives, it’s an ideal time to explore opportunities in this growing market.
For those seeking more than just a property, something with prestige, prime location, and long-term value, DarGlobal presents the perfect gateway. Through thoughtfully curated developments like L’Horizon and Les Vagues by Elie Saab , we deliver not just homes, but high-performing investments that align with Qatar’s exciting future.

title: LET IT RAIN DIAMONDS: DAR GLOBAL AND MOUAWAD HIGH JEWELLERY HOUSE UNVEIL SAR 880 MILLION LANDMARK RESIDENTIAL PROJECT
headings: Let it Rain Diamonds: Dar Global and Mouawad High Jewellery House Unveil SAR 880 Million Landmark Residential Project
content:
Let it Rain Diamonds: Dar Global and Mouawad High Jewellery House Unveil SAR 880 Million Landmark Residential Project
Mouawad Boutique, The Peninsula Hotel, London, United Kingdom; 23 September 2024:
Dar Global, the London-Stock Exchange listed international real estate company, has entered into a landmark partnership with Mouawad, the luxury jeweler, to launch a unique SAR 880 million (GBP 180 million) residential project close to World Expo 2030 in the North of Riyadh. The high-profile collaboration represents Dar Global’s debut in the Saudi market, a significant milestone in the company’s international expansion strategy. The project also marks Mouawad’s planned move into the luxury residential sector, where it will apply its reputation as a leader in refined craftsmanship to expand its operations into new frontiers.
Set for handover in Q4 of 2026, the luxury development of 200 residential villas will become one of Riyadh’s most prestigious addresses, bringing together the expertise of Dar Global, known for its innovative approach to high-end real estate, and Mouawad’s legacy of creative and artistic mastery. Blending contemporary design, meticulous attention to detail, and timeless elegance, each residence will embody the brands' commitment to quality and luxury, offering a unique blend of sophisticated aesthetics and enduring style for the most discerning buyers.
Owners of residential properties worth 4 million Saudi Riyals and above are granted eligibility to Real Estate Owner Residency under the Saudi Premium Residency program. The program, coupled with co-branded luxury real estate offerings have increased the Kingdom’s appeal to international investors, and further enhance Riyadh’s status as an emerging global destination for luxury living.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “This is a proud moment for Dar Global as we bring our international expertise and high standards of living to the Saudi market. Our partnership with Mouawad, a brand synonymous with diamonds, luxury and artistic craftsmanship, is an embodiment of our shared vision to offer a unique, globally-inspired living experience in Riyadh. We aspire for this project to stand as a benchmark of luxury and elegance, much like the renowned Bulgari Residences. It underscores our commitment to enhancing the Kingdom’s real estate offering with developments that stand at the intersection of modernity, elegance, and timeless design.”
Renowned for crafting exquisite jewels, Mouawad’s expansion into luxury real estate is a significant milestone in its illustrious history. With a legacy that spans over 130 years, Mouawad has set the standard for luxury in the world of fine jewelry and watches. Now, for the first time, the brand is bringing its celebrated craftsmanship and design ethos to the realm of real estate.
Pascal Mouawad, Fourth Generation Co-Guardian of Mouawad, commented: "For more than a century, Mouawad has long been a hallmark of luxury and enduring elegance. Our collaboration with Dar Global enables us to expand our legacy into the realm of branded residences, infusing our unique identity into prestigious developments around the world. We believe this milestone will set a new standard for luxury living in the real estate market."
Dar Global’s debut in the Saudi market is part of its broader strategy to introduce its internationally recognized standards of luxury to Saudi Arabia’s growing real estate sector. With an established track record across the Middle East and Europe, Dar Global is set to deliver unparalleled sophistication to a market increasingly defined by discerning, globally mobile buyers.

title: DarGlobal Launches Sales for AIDA: Trump Golf Course Community in Muscat
headings: Dar Global Launches Sales for AIDA, a one-of-a-kind mixed-use gated community featuring Trump Golf Course and the Ultimate in Luxury Golf, Residential, and Hospitality Experiences in Muscat, Oman, the new hidden gem
content:
Dar Global Launches Sales for AIDA, a one-of-a-kind mixed-use gated community featuring Trump Golf Course and the Ultimate in Luxury Golf, Residential, and Hospitality Experiences in Muscat, Oman, the new hidden gem
Muscat, Oman; 16 th March 2023: Dar Global, the renowned international luxury real estate developer, has officially launched the sales of AIDA, one of Oman’s most significant premium mixed-use real estate projects directly by the sea, located just 10 minutes from Downtown Muscat. AIDA is set to redefine luxury living, offering a unique landscape with stunning elevated sea views of over 130 meters above sea level.
The 3.5 million square metre property, perched atop a hilltop, provides breathtaking views, immersive experiences, enchanting residences, facilities, and spectacular outdoor landscapes. AIDA’s master plan was designed to ensure innovative standards by adopting architectural foundations and utilising rich natural surroundings. Most importantly, AIDA is being developed sustainably, fully respecting and preserving the area’s topography and unique environmental features, with homes integrating seamlessly within the cliffs.
Designed to reimagine the concept of place creation and built in unison with its natural surroundings, AIDA represents one of Oman’s largest urban developments. The project is a ground-breaking initiative that will set a new standard in the region, further elevating Oman’s stand globally as a sought-after tourist, residential, and investment destination.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, commented on the sales launch: “ AIDA builds on our strategic aspiration of regional and global expansion through unique, high-quality developments that cater to a discerning clientele of global citizens. With the sales launch of this master project, we anticipate a strong response from the community of international investors, creating an even stronger resonance around Oman’s persona as a world-class destination.”
Dar Global’s AIDA project is a joint venture with Omran Group, the Sultanate’s executive arm for tourism development, to advance Oman’s real estate market in line with the country’s Vision 2040. The project is part of Dar Global’s collaboration with the Trump Organization and is poised to offer an unmatched luxury experience to both tourists and residents. This ambitious project is expected to drive tourism in Oman and bolster the country’s property market, supporting the goals of Vision 2040. By combining the expertise of Dar Global, Omran Group, and the Trump Organization, AIDA promises to set a new standard for luxury living in Oman and beyond.
Dar Global is a 28-year-old real estate development company operating across the entire industry’s value chain with innovation and technology at its core. Leveraging its extensive experience and understanding of the industry, Dar Global focuses on developing elegantly designed residences catering to the second and vacation homes market in central locations in the Middle East and Europe. The company is fast-growing its portfolio across the world with developments in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Qatar, Oman, Bosnia, the United Kingdom (UK), and Spain. Some prominent projects include Urban Oasis tower in collaboration with Missoni, Da Vinci tower with interiors by Pagani, Les Vagues residences by Elie Saab, and the W Residences Dubai – Downtown. Dar Global also has offices in the UAE, China, the UK, and Spain to manage its global project portfolio and serve its international clientele. www.DarGlobal.co.uk

title: DarGlobal Boosts GDV 67% to $12.5B with New Saudi Developments & Financial Services Entry
headings: DarGlobal Grows GDV by 67% to $12.5bln as it Launches New Developments in Saudi Arabia and Enters Financial Services
content:
DarGlobal Grows GDV by 67% to $12.5bln as it Launches New Developments in Saudi Arabia and Enters Financial Services
DarGlobal, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, today announces a series of strategic milestones that highlight both the strength of the Company’s core markets and the scale of its long-term growth strategy.
The Group is pleased to announce the following:
It has secured a new significant joint development agreement with Dar Al Arkan* and completed strategic land acquisitions for large-scale projects in Riyadh and Jeddah. These will raise the Group’s Gross Development Value to approximately US$12.5 billion.
A strengthened liquidity position through the successful expansion of the Company’s Litmus financing facility (‘Litmus Facility’) from US$275 million to US$440 million.
A strategic acquisition of a licensed financial services platform in the DIFC which will allow Dar Global to provide complementary asset management and financial advisory capabilities and strengthen its ability to attract international capital in real estate through funds and thereby enabling participation in larger-scale opportunities with reduced risk exposure.
Strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia
The new large-scale projects in Saudi Arabia will significantly expand Dar Global’s development footprint, involving two large-scale communities with a combined GDV of around US $4.8 billion. In Riyadh, the Company has secured development rights through partial land acquisition and joint development agreement over a major integrated scheme valued at US $2.8 billion, anchored by a US $300 million land acquisition (partial portion of integrated scheme) which will be acquired in place of the Riyadh land acquisition announced by the Group on 17 March 2025. The Company has decided to pursue this development instead because it provides the potential to deliver greater scale and enhanced profitability while reducing development risk.
In Jeddah, a further joint development agreement covers a landmark mixed-use project on one of the city’s most prominent land parcels, with an estimated GDV of US$1.95 billion.
This expansion capitalises on Saudi Arabia’s rapid economic transformation, as it opens up to foreign ownership and the sustained demand for world-class real estate in the Kingdom. These are significant parcels of land with the opportunity to develop luxury villas, a world-class golf course and a luxury hotel.
This new strategic expansion in Saudi Arabia not only increases the scale of Dar Global’s pipeline but also illustrates the Group’s ability to structure transactions that balance investment exposure with long-term profitability.
Litmus Facility increased enhancing liquidity
To accelerate delivery of the Group’s expanding portfolio, the new Litmus Facility will strengthen Dar Global’s liquidity position by US$165 million.  The facility is underwritten by Emirates NBD and supported by ADCB, FAB and Zand Bank.  The structure is secured by the pledge of shares and backed by corporate guarantees.  This enhanced liquidity will accelerate the Company’s existing projects and enable greater flexibility in pursuing new opportunities across the Middle East, Europe and North America, reinforcing long‑term resilience and execution capacity.
Entry into financial services via DIFC
In a move that diversifies the Group’s operations, Dar Global is acquiring a licensed financial services company in the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). The entity is authorised to provide a wide suite of services including asset management, investment banking, and advisory activities. Operated as an independent subsidiary with its own governance structure, the platform will allow Dar Global to broaden its revenue streams and reduce reliance on development cycles.
It will also equip Dar Global with the ability to create and manage investment vehicles that attract institutional and private capital from the GCC and beyond, enabling participation in larger‑scale projects in a capital efficient manner. The acquisition also provides immediate regulatory readiness, avoiding the lengthier process of applying for a new license and positions Dar Global as both a developer and a financial platform that is agile and able to mobilise international capital into real estate opportunities. The Company plans to expand the team and diversify its offering.
Together, the strategic milestones announced today reinforce Dar Global’s position as a diversified international developer, combining a strong Saudi pipeline with enhanced capital strength and a new financial services platform to support long-term growth and value creation for investors and stakeholders. This success is further bolstered by Dar Global's proven collaboration with landowners, government entities, and world-renowned luxury and hospitality brands, solidifying its leadership in delivering bespoke, high-end investment opportunities to affluent, globally mobile customers.
Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “These milestones mark an important inflection point for Dar Global.  In Saudi Arabia, we are delivering landmark projects in prime locations and looking to bring in more overseas investment as the Kingdom opens up.
“The enhanced financing facility reinforces our balance sheet to fuel growth at scale and the establishment of a financial services arm in DIFC enhances our ability to structure capital and unlock global opportunities that previously would not have been available to the Group.
“Together, these initiatives reflect not just confidence in our strategy, but also the unique position we occupy as a bridge between high-growth markets and international investors.  We look forward to providing further updates on these exciting initiatives as they progress.”

DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging - value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.
Our premium properties are strategically located in established and emerging markets. Creating opportunities to expand your world. While growing your wealth. Our international portfolio spans exquisite residences, vacation retreats, world-class hospitality, and developments with iconic luxury brands, including Aston Martin, and Lamborghini. Design. Lifestyle. Investment value. Every DarGlobal property seeks to enrich all three.
True global citizens want to live without borders. Or compromises. We offer thoughtfully designed homes in desirable settings that cater to your international way of life. Freedom and flexibility. Comfort and culture. Security and service. Wherever you go, find the fundamentals here.
We draw on over 31 years of luxury development experience to move with agility. Adapting to stay ahead of the market. Anticipating investors’ needs. Leveraging exceptional talent and partnerships. Always guided by purpose. Our commitment to quality and people-first thinking sets us apart. We don’t just build differently. We’re built different.
